card.statement:
For any $\lambda\in X_{*}(T)^{+}$ , we have a canonical isomorphism

$\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{k})\cong\mathbf{k}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\otimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{Z}), \mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{k})\cong\mathbf{k}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\otimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{Z}).$
card.label: Proposition 11.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
